mapper.select: SELECT workspace_id FROM workspace_domains WHERE domain_key = #{domainKey} AND active = 'Y'
mapper.sql: (SELECT md.name FROM project_members pm JOIN workspace_members wm ON pm.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id JOIN member_details md ON wm.member_id = md.member_id WHERE pm.project_id = p.project_id AND pm.status = 0 AND pm.role = 70 AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS pm_name
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_members pm WHERE pm.project_id = p.project_id AND pm.status = 0 ) AS member_count

if.test: status != null and status != 'all' and status != ''

choose.when: AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_members pm JOIN workspace_members wm ON pm.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id JOIN member_details md ON wm.member_id = md.member_id WHERE pm.project_id = p.project_id AND pm.status = 0 AND pm.role = 70 AND LOWER(md.name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%')
choose.otherwise: AND (LOWER(p.subject) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(p.content) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_members pm JOIN workspace_members wm ON pm.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id JOIN member_details md ON wm.member_id = md.member_id WHERE pm.project_id = p.project_id AND pm.status = 0 AND pm.role = 70 AND LOWER(md.name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%') )

mapper.select:
SELECT p.project_id, p.workspace_id, p.subject, p.content, TO_CHAR(p.start_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS start_date, TO_CHAR(p."END", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS end_date, p.status, p.progress, p.archive, TO_CHAR(p.created, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS created, ,
FROM projects p JOIN workspace_domains wd ON p.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id WHERE wd.domain_key = #{domainKey} AND wd.active = 'Y' AND p.deleted IS NULL
ORDER BY p.project_id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projects p JOIN workspace_domains wd ON p.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id WHERE wd.domain_key = #{domainKey} AND wd.active = 'Y' AND p.deleted IS NULL
mapper.insert:

mapper.select:
SELECT p.project_id, p.workspace_id, p.subject, p.content, TO_CHAR(p.start_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS start_date, TO_CHAR(p."END", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS end_date, p.status, p.progress, ,
FROM projects p JOIN workspace_domains wd ON p.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId} AND wd.domain_key = #{domainKey} AND wd.active = 'Y' AND p.deleted IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projects p JOIN workspace_domains wd ON p.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id JOIN project_members pm ON p.project_id = pm.project_id JOIN workspace_members wm ON pm.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId} AND wd.domain_key = #{domainKey} AND wd.active = 'Y' AND p.deleted IS NULL AND wm.member_id = #{memberId} AND pm.status = 0 AND pm.role = 70
mapper.update: UPDATE projects SET subject = #{subject}, content = #{content}, start_at = TO_DATE(#{start_date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), "END" = TO_DATE(#{end_date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), status = #{status}, updated = SYSDATE WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND deleted IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM workspace_domains wd WHERE wd.workspace_id = projects.workspace_id AND wd.domain_key = #{domainKey} AND wd.active = 'Y')
mapper.select: SELECT t.task_id, t.project_id, t.project_member_id, t.title, t.content, t.task_level, TO_CHAR(t.start_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS start_date, TO_CHAR(t."END", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS end_date, t.status, t.progress, md.name AS tl_name FROM tasks t JOIN projects p ON t.project_id = p.project_id JOIN workspace_domains wd ON p.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id JOIN project_members pm ON t.project_member_id = pm.project_member_id JOIN workspace_members wm ON pm.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id JOIN member_details md ON wm.member_id = md.member_id WHERE t.project_id = #{projectId} AND wd.domain_key = #{domainKey} AND wd.active = 'Y' AND p.deleted IS NULL AND t.deleted IS NULL ORDER BY t.task_id

SELECT pm.project_member_id AS "project_member_id", md.name AS "tl_name" FROM project_members pm JOIN projects p ON pm.project_id = p.project_id JOIN workspace_domains wd ON p.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id JOIN workspace_members wm ON pm.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id JOIN member_details md ON wm.member_id = md.member_id WHERE pm.project_id = #{projectId} AND wd.domain_key = #{domainKey} AND wd.active = 'Y' AND p.deleted IS NULL AND pm.role = 30 AND pm.status = 0 ORDER BY md.name
